title: Subnet News — August 18, 2026
summary: Forty percent of subnet markets were rising at the daily snapshot, led by RedTeam, while Teutonic absorbed a concentrated 816 TAO wallet outflow. Fresh subnet work included Reliquary's new Qwen3-4B DAPO profile, Lium GPU power-cap verification, Ridges Kubernetes verifier permissions, Score's image-size scoring fix, and new operating clarifications from NIOME and Cascade. Two separate Quasar conviction reductions above 50,000 alpha were recorded as real same-day on-chain actions, not assumed sales or guaranteed cliff releases.

highlights.headline: Forty percent of subnet markets rise as RedTeam leads the daily tape
highlights.summary: SubnetRadar's August 18 issue showed 40% of subnet markets positive, with RedTeam up 17.5% and SN70 down 13.9%. The live Shizzy snapshot taken after the cutoff still showed more declining than advancing markets. These are market observations, not predictions or recommendations.

highlights.headline: Seven tracked wallets remove 816 TAO from Teutonic before cutoff
highlights.summary: At 9:05 UTC, SubnetRadar recorded seven historically profitable wallets removing a combined 816 TAO from SN3, led by one 286-TAO movement. The provider labels and transactions are observable, but they do not establish coordination, motive or future price direction.

upcomingUnlocks.name: Quasar
upcomingUnlocks.summary: A Quasar hotkey reduced its conviction lock by approximately 130,300 alpha through a real on-chain action. The same dashboard also records new Quasar locks in the period, so this is reported as a gross reduction rather than a guaranteed cliff release or evidence that the alpha was sold.

upcomingUnlocks.name: Quasar
upcomingUnlocks.summary: A second Quasar hotkey reduced its conviction lock by approximately 103,000 alpha through a separate on-chain action. A nearby 150,300-alpha lock on that hotkey means the event must not be described as a simple one-day token cliff or assumed sale.

updates.headline: Score corrects image dimensions used by its polygon scorer
updates.summary: Score replaced placeholder one-by-one image dimensions with dimensions read from the real frame when available, adding tests around the adaptive intersection-over-union path. The fix addresses a concrete scoring-input defect; its effect on live rankings was not independently measured by cutoff.

updates.headline: Lium verifies GPU persistence after applying power caps
updates.summary: Lium now reads back both the applied GPU power limit and persistence mode after changing a cap. It warns when persistence is off because the cap can revert after a driver unload, while avoiding false warnings when the field is unavailable. This extends yesterday’s hardware-truth work with a new operational safeguard.

updates.headline: NIOME clarifies its 720-block task cadence and pool separation
updates.summary: The team said one scoring interval lasts 720 blocks, roughly 2.4 hours, and miners should expect new tasks at that cadence. It also recommended keeping cas9 and cas12a work in separate pools to avoid skewed result distribution. These are new operating clarifications, distinct from yesterday’s consistency-score dispute.

updates.headline: Ridges adds narrowly scoped Kubernetes capabilities for verifier cleanup
updates.summary: Ridges added DAC_OVERRIDE, FOWNER and CHOWN to the root verifier container so it can reset agent-owned worktrees, while documenting that a non-root agent process does not retain those capabilities. Tests now pin the intended capability set. This changes verifier execution plumbing, not miner rewards.

updates.headline: Reliquary ships a Qwen3-4B Base DAPO v4 protocol profile
updates.summary: Reliquary merged a large v4 profile centered on Qwen3-4B Base, expanded to sixteen trajectories per prompt, and added protocol, admission, training, verifier and integrity changes with new tests and runbooks. The public merge is verified; production training results were not yet independently available.

updates.headline: Cascade documents its shipped mainnet competition settings
updates.summary: Cascade updated its public documentation to match the live configuration: roughly one-hour heats, a 4M live final size, a tenure-decaying dethrone margin from 2% to 0.5% over eight rounds, and geometric reward decay across the current king and four prior kings. This clarifies already-shipped mechanics rather than announcing a new launch.

updates.headline: Actual governance debate escalates while mining remains pending
updates.summary: Official-channel discussion focused on founder engagement, partial venture funding and communication with token holders. Team members defended a product-first approach, but no firm mining launch date or product release was supplied. The debate is verified as community activity; the competing governance claims remain developing.

updates.headline: Ditto moves v11 agent review into an active moderation phase
updates.summary: With v11 active, the team confirmed ongoing manual agent review and requests to examine unusually high memory scores. Moderators also applied temporary timeouts over unsupported cheating accusations. Review activity is verified, but individual cheating claims remain unproven.

ecosystem.headline: Network conviction reaches 29.54 million alpha while the perpetual share holds at 86%
ecosystem.summary: SubnetRadar showed 29.54 million alpha locked across 123 subnets, with 25.41 million perpetual and 4.13 million decaying. Network conviction fell 0.5% over 24 hours. Decaying positions release continuously on their curves; the separate Quasar reductions appear only in Unlock Watch.

ecosystem.headline: One fewer subnet sits in the 90%-plus miner-burn band
ecosystem.summary: The daily count moved from 43 to 42 of 128 reporting subnets with miner burn at or above 90%. No completed alpha halving, new registration, deregistration or slot replacement was independently verified inside the window.
